description_en: Queries the list of topics under a specified data source in the rules engine by paging
description_zh: 调用该接口分页查询规则引擎中指定数据源下的Topic列表
kebab_example: aliyun iot list-data-source-item --iot-instance-id iot-0pp1n8t000 --page-size 10 --data-source-id 1001 --page 1 --search-name thing --api-version 2018-01-20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListDataSourceItem

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID. You can view the ID of the current instance on the Overview page in the IoT Platform console.

<notice>
If this parameter is available, you must specify this parameter. Otherwise, the call fails.
If the Overview page or the ID is not available, you do not need to specify this parameter.

</notice>

For more information about instances, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。您可在物联网平台控制台的实例概览页面，查看当前实例的ID。

<notice>
若有ID值，必须传入该ID值，否则调用会失败。
若无实例概览页面或ID值，则无需传入。

</notice>

实例的更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.name: iot_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The number of records per page. Valid values: 1 to 100
parameters.help_zh: 指定返回结果中每页显示的记录数量，取值范围为1~100
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The data source ID.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/432676.html operation to view all data source IDs of the current instance
parameters.help_zh:
数据源ID。

调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/432676.html接口，可查看当前实例下所有数据源ID
parameters.name: data_source_id

parameters.help_en: The page number. Valid values: 1 to 100000
parameters.help_zh: 指定显示返回结果中的第几页，取值范围为1~100,000
parameters.name: page

parameters.help_en: A string segment of a topic value. Topics that match this string are returned
parameters.help_zh: 传入Topic值中任意一段字符串，根据该字符串检索能匹配的Topic
parameters.name: search_name

Code.description_en: The error code returned if the call fails. For more information, see [Error codes]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87387.html）
Code.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的错误码。更多信息，请参见[错误码]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87387.html）

DataSourceItemId.description_en: The ID of the data source topic

DeviceName.description_en:
The device name to which the message topic belongs.

This parameter is returned when the message topic belongs to a product and device of the open-source MQTT managed type or the MQTT cloud gateway type
DeviceName.description_zh:
消息Topic所属的设备名称。

消息Topic属于开源MQTT托管形态产品和设备或MQTT云网关产品和设备时，返回该参数

ProductKey.description_en:
The ProductKey of the product to which the message topic belongs.

This parameter is returned when the message topic belongs to a product and device of the open-source MQTT managed type or the MQTT cloud gateway type
ProductKey.description_zh:
消息Topic所属产品的ProductKey。

消息Topic属于开源MQTT托管形态产品和设备，或MQTT云网关产品和设备时，返回该参数

ScopeType.description_en:
The scope of the message topic subscription. Valid values:

PRODUCT: product-level. The subscription applies to all devices under the product.
DEVICE: device-level. The subscription applies to a specified device under the product.

This parameter is returned when the message topic belongs to a product and device of the open-source MQTT managed type or the MQTT cloud gateway type
ScopeType.description_zh:
消息Topic订阅的作用域，可取值：

**PRODUCT **：产品维度，表示作用在产品下的所有设备上。
**DEVICE **：设备维度，表示作用在产品下指定的设备上。

消息Topic属于开源MQTT托管形态产品和设备，或MQTT云网关产品和设备时，返回该参数

Topic.description_en: The value of the data source topic

ErrorMessage.description_en: The error message returned if the call fails
ErrorMessage.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的出错信息

Page.description_en: The page number of the returned results
Page.description_zh: 显示返回结果中的第几页

PageSize.description_en: The number of records per page in the response
PageSize.description_zh: 返回结果中每页显示的记录数量

RequestId.description_en: The unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request
RequestId.description_zh: 阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the call was successful.
true: The call was successful.
false: The call failed
Success.description_zh:
表示是否调用成功。
true：调用成功。
false：调用失败

Total.description_en: The total number of records returned
